blocks.text: Addiction Rehab Ottawa is a residential addiction and substance abuse facility. We offer superior care and treatment for individuals suffering from alcoholism and drug addiction. Each of the treatment programs we offer are designed to offer our graduates with the tools needed for a long-life, as well as sustainable recovery. We provide patients with treatment programs that last 30 days, 60 days, or 90 days to meet their needs, as well as an extended aftercare program. Our team has a high rate of success with previous clients, and the addiction treatment services we offer for alcohol and drug abuse is proven effective. Our staff includes several professionals including positive peer mentors, substance abuse specialists, addiction counselors, and professional therapists.

children.heading: We Offer Holistic and Individualized Options for Addiction Treatment

blocks.text: At Addiction Rehab Ottawa, we don’t just treat the addiction. We treat the entire person to ensure they can overcome the issue they suffer. With our holistic approach, a person is able to recover from the issue and we provide strategies and methods that support the person as a whole. We address all areas of a person’s life – social aspects, emotional issues, psychological problems, physical symptoms and more to ensure the addiction is overcome for good.

With our holistic approach, a person is able to recover from the issue and we provide strategies and methods that support the person as a whole. We address all areas of a person’s life – social aspects, emotional issues, psychological problems, physical symptoms and more to ensure the addiction is overcome for good.

blocks.text: We work to boost a person’s psychological resilience, as well as their immunity to help them cope on their own, without having to turn to abusing a substance. By reducing depression, anxiety and a number of other behavioral issues, our holistic healing treatment methods can effectively minimize and eliminate withdrawal symptoms while working to prevent relapse.

raw_html:
Treatments For Addiction

At Canadian Addiction Rehab in Ottawa, we offer a wide array of inpatient treatment plans for a various addictions.

Addiction Rehab Ottawa is a residential addiction and substance abuse facility. We offer superior care and treatment for individuals suffering from alcoholism and drug addiction. Each of the treatment programs we offer are designed to offer our graduates with the tools needed for a long-life, as well as sustainable recovery. We provide patients with treatment programs that last 30 days, 60 days, or 90 days to meet their needs, as well as an extended aftercare program. Our team has a high rate of success with previous clients, and the addiction treatment services we offer for alcohol and drug abuse is proven effective. Our staff includes several professionals including positive peer mentors, substance abuse specialists, addiction counselors, and professional therapists.

Find A Drug Rehab

We offer treatment for a number of different issues, including:

  • Opioid addiction
  • Amphetamine addiction
  • Alcohol addiction
  • Party/club drug addiction
  • Sex addiction
  • Marijuana addiction
  • Meth addiction
  • Heroin addiction
  • Cocaine addiction

We offer the treatment options needed for a person to overcome the addiction they suffer.

Find A Drug Rehab

We Offer Holistic and Individualized Options for Addiction Treatment

At Addiction Rehab Ottawa, we don’t just treat the addiction. We treat the entire person to ensure they can overcome the issue they suffer. With our holistic approach, a person is able to recover from the issue and we provide strategies and methods that support the person as a whole. We address all areas of a person’s life – social aspects, emotional issues, psychological problems, physical symptoms and more to ensure the addiction is overcome for good.

We work to boost a person’s psychological resilience, as well as their immunity to help them cope on their own, without having to turn to abusing a substance. By reducing depression, anxiety and a number of other behavioral issues, our holistic healing treatment methods can effectively minimize and eliminate withdrawal symptoms while working to prevent relapse.

Find A Drug Rehab

Providing an Individualized Treatment Method

Our staff has first-hand experience with addiction, and, as a result, understands that no two people are the same, which means cookie-cutter addiction treatment plans are simply not effective. We work to create custom treatment programs for each patient that comes to us. To ensure the right treatment methods are utilized, we complete a comprehensive assessment during the admissions process.

Some of the treatment options we offer at Addiction Rehab Ottawa include:

  • Group, one-on-one, and family counseling
  • Meditation
  • Recreational activities
  • Private meetings with social workers
  • Relapse prevention
  • Introduction to the 12 steps program
  • Sober living
  • Leadership training
  • Anger management
Contact Us Today

These are just a few of the treatment methods we employ at Addiction Rehab Ottawa.

If you are worried about your own, or a loved one’s alcohol or drug addiction, don’t wait for them to hit the bottom. Call us today to have a unique treatment plan created for the addiction they suffer.

Talk To One Of Our Specialists By Calling 1-855-885-4747
